newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Several hurt in Swiss mountain cable car accident.
newsitem.headline: Several hurt in Swiss mountain cable car accident.

text.p: Several people were hurt when a technical defect sent gondolas on a Swiss mountain cable car crashing to the ground on Saturday, police in the southeastern canton of Valais said.
The victims were flown by helicopter to hospitals in the area after the accident on the Riedleralp around 0900 GMT, police said.
Several gondolas fell from the overhead cable, they said.
Swiss radio put the number of injured at around 10.
